errata.evidence: Spanish spells it 'sistemas', as this edition does on its cataloguing page (p. 4: 'fortalecer los sistemas de salud'). The misspelling is repeated on the title page (p. 3) and in the running head (from p. 5).

narrative.text: The cover title misspells 'sistemas' as 'systemas'; the cataloguing record in the same edition spells it correctly.

errata.quote: En esta directriz se presentan nueve recomendaciones
errata.evidence: The same edition numbers its recommendations up to 10: 'Recomendación 10' on pp. 24, 25, 108 and 112.

narrative.text: Chapter 3 announces nine recommendations, but the guideline sets out ten.
